items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Willie Humphrey was actually my first teacher.

ctx.x: Okay, we were going on about your life, about when you started.
Yeah, that's right, when I started. Well, like I said, Willie Humphrey was actually my first teacher.
What kind of a horn did you have? A hornet or a hornet?
